events.title: The Investigation Continues — Major Demo Update
events.summary: The Wild East: The Straw Man demo has received a major update with a substantial new playable continuation. Previously, Kábel’s refusal brought this path through the investigation to an early end. It is no longer a dead end. Marek can now recover from the setback, pursue a different lead and continue through an extensive new sequence all the way to the current demo ending. events.title: The Demo Just Got a Major Update
events.summary: Our biggest demo update so far is here We have released a major update for the Wild East: The Straw Man demo. It touches nearly every part of the experience—from voices and character animation to controls, scale, room artwork, and overall polish. The investigation remains familiar, but the way it looks, sounds, and plays has changed significantly. Voice acting and language options Extensive voice acting has been added throughout the demo. events.title: Demo Update – July 21, 2026
events.summary: A new update for the Wild East: The Straw Man demo is now available.• Improved left- and right-click interactions and hotspot reliability• Added footsteps synchronized with character walking animations• Added soft contact shadows to better ground characters in the environment• Additional interaction and stability fixesThank you for playing!

events.title: Demo Update - July 16, 2026
events.summary: Today's update improves the presentation and behavior of the Wild East: The Straw Man Demo. - Smoother horizontal camera movement in wide locations - Improved fullscreen scaling across different display aspect ratios - Black letterboxing where required - Additional minor stability and presentation improvements Existing save files remain compatible. \]Play the demo on Steam\
